notes.title: Recovery
notes.content: Hello friends, unfortunately I lost my ssd with game files for this and The Ruins so i have had to rebuild them. this one should be up to date and hopefully fixes the existing issue with the most recent update where in multiplayer you dont spawn

notes.title: stability update
notes.content: stability update fixed some bugs. i am now shifting focus to another game! ive been very busy lately with real life things but i thank you all for your purchases!

notes.title: Bug Fixes and map reworks
notes.content: Fixed some animations, reworked some maps and fixed small bugs throughout

notes.title: bug fixes
notes.content: fixed pause binding and added return to desktop option in game. fixed some other minor bugs

notes.title: hopefully fixed launch issue with new update
MAP dump!
notes.content: New levels mostly for multiplayer, new game mechanics in effect. New level using trick shots to progress. hope you're enjoying it so far!

notes.title: Added Spleef
notes.content:
Spleef has just been added in the multiplayer! as of now there is just one level, with more to come.
fixed some bugs, still working on a fix for the host not having a water texture on the island map. Very strange issue. next maps will include very large food. Huge thank you again for buying the game!! If you'd like I'd love you to leave a review with honest feedback :)
